facts.fact: BurundiPay lets users pay and transfer funds in real time from bank accounts and mobile wallets, the BRB says.
BurundiPay is stated to rest on full interoperability between commercial banks, microfinance institutions and payment institutions, with payments from bank accounts and mobile wallets.
The BRB launched BurundiPay as the national instant payment system, usable from bank accounts and mobile wallets, alongside the existing national payment switch.
